name: MFA on email and cloud apps for all users
framework_text_summary: Is MFA enforced for all users on email and cloud applications?
tested: Share of enabled people and admin accounts with MFA reported in every system they exist in. Pass at 98% or more, partial at 80% or more. Registration, not enforcement.
gap: Registration, not enforcement; insurers ask about enforcement.

name: MFA on privileged and admin accounts

tested: Enabled accounts with admin rights in any inspected identity system, and whether each has MFA reported in every system it exists in (Identity & access "Admins without MFA"). name: Leavers removed and dormant accounts disabled
framework_text_summary: Are accounts removed promptly when staff leave?
